notice: FICTIONAL DEMO DATA. All operators, people and requests in this file are made up for demonstration purposes. Any resemblance to real companies is coincidental.

requests.text: At the end of every month I spend two full days in spreadsheets working out what each guide is owed. Some are paid per tour, some per guest, and then there are tips on top. Is there any way to see this in one place?

Availability in Bokun and in your system went out of sync again over the weekend and we sold 6 seats on a Vatican tour that was already full. We had to refund and apologise to everyone. This is the third time this month.
We get a lot of school and cruise groups of 30 to 50 people and right now we have to enter them as individual bookings. It's a nightmare every time the teacher changes the headcount.
Guests keep emailing us the night before asking what time we'll pick them up from their hotel. Could the confirmation show the exact pickup time for their hotel instead of just the tour start time?
Our corporate clients need proper VAT invoices with their company name and VAT number on them. At the moment we're recreating every invoice by hand in our accounting software after the booking.
Can you give me a monthly report per guide? Which tours they led, how many hours, and how much we owe them. My accountant keeps asking for it and I have nothing to send.
Bookings that come in through Bokun from the OTAs sometimes show up hours late, or with the wrong number of participants. Our team only notices when the guide counts people at the meeting point.
Our northern lights tours leave at different times depending on the forecast. We need a quick way to move the pickup time for everyone on a departure and let them all know.
When a Colosseum slot sells out people still ask to join. Could customers add themselves to a waiting list and get a message automatically if somebody cancels?
A travel agency wants us to hold 40 seats on our Edinburgh day trip without paying upfront, and release whatever they don't use 7 days before departure. Is that something we can set up?
My guides are freelancers and send me an invoice at the end of the month. I'd love to send each of them a summary of the walks they did, so we agree on the amount before they invoice me.
Could you add Japanese to the booking widget? We're seeing a lot more guests from Japan this season.
VAT on our boat trips is different from our land tours. The invoice has to show the rates separately per line, otherwise our accountant sends it back.
Our drivers never know who to collect where. We need a printable pickup list per vehicle, sorted by time, that they can take with them in the morning.
When we add new departure times in Bokun they don't appear on your side until someone re-imports the product manually. Can this sync happen on its own?
Tips collected on the card reader end up in one pot. How do we split them between the guide and the driver and show it on their monthly pay?
We give 10% off for parties of 10 or more, but staff have to apply it by hand and they often forget. Can the discount kick in automatically for big groups?
We run small groups of max 12. When someone cancels I go through my inbox and email the people who asked earlier whether a spot opened up. It would be great if this happened by itself.
Our office laptop died and nobody remembers which email address the main account was registered with. Can you help us get back in?
Business clients from Germany and France keep asking for invoices that show their own VAT ID. Does your system support that, or do we keep doing it in Word?
Since yesterday every booking from Bokun arrives twice. We've been cancelling the duplicates by hand all morning.
Is there a way to export the emails of customers who agreed to marketing? We want to send a winter newsletter.
